recommendation_summary: The reply rejects the APPROVED column, typed initials and naming convention. It recommends keeping the shared folder for drafts only and adding a controlled release archive now. The archive requires authenticated approval by someone other than the author, records the approval time against the exact released version, and locks that version and its approval record against change or deletion for seven years. It offers no optional additions and leaves no needs unmet.
note: The recommendation has every LARGER capability, but the reply has none of the four required record labels, so all record predicates fail.
